searchDocs.title: Introduction to eUNC​
searchDocs.content: eUNC is a standard that attempts to unify and standardize the requirements and things involved in developing scripts for external tooling.  External tooling most notably have severe issues when it comes to these. Environments are always non-standard, all over the place, with little to no information about how they behave or anything.  With eUNC, we attempt to change that for the better, by directly tackling the issue at hand and standardizing the environment that scripts are developed in, providing defacto libraries and functionality in a standard manner.  The eUNC spec is divided in Capabilities. If a tool boasts capability of some sort, then they must have the mentioned features, else, it will not be compliant.

searchDocs.title: WorldToScreen​
searchDocs.content: </> rendering.WorldToScreen( partOrPosition: BasePart | Vector3 -- The part or Position to project. ) → ( Vector2 , boolean )-- A tuple containing first a Vector2, representing the position of the object in pixels, with containing second whether the object is visible on screen. Attempts to project the position/ part into the screen space. Implementation for Part objects The underlying implementation may vary for Part objects. Some implementations may cache positions and update them periodically, or they may retrieve the position on call. WARNING This function may support positions that are slightly off-screen on some implementations.

searchDocs.title: Name​
searchDocs.content: This item is read only and cannot be modified. Read Only </> instance.Name: string Contains the Name of the object. Readonly Validity This property may be safe to read/write on certain conditions. However this behaviour is not guaranteed by spec.

searchDocs.title: ClassName​
searchDocs.content: This item is read only and cannot be modified. Read Only </> instance.ClassName: string Contains the ClassName of the object, held in its class descriptor.

searchDocs.title: Parent​
searchDocs.content: This item is read only and cannot be modified. Read Only </> instance.Parent: instance? The parent of the instance, may be nil.

searchDocs.title: Address​
searchDocs.content: This item is read only and cannot be modified. Read Only </> instance.Address: number The address of the instance in roblox memory.

searchDocs.title: IsA​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:IsA( className: string-- The name of the class that is checked for inheritance. ) → boolean-- Whether the object's class inherits from className Performs an inheritance check, validating whether the object's class derives from the given className

searchDocs.title: Unlock​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:Unlock() → () Attempts to unlock the reference to the underlying instance. After this call, operations with the instance may crash, error or trigger undefined behaviour. Safety Unlocking releases the reference for the tool to clear it up. It will not 'unlock' the object on the actual engine.

searchDocs.title: Lock​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:Lock() → boolean-- Whether the instance was locked successfully. Attempts to lock the reference to the underlying instance. After this call, all operations with it are valid. This guarantees no errors when calling functions. Safety Locking guarantees that state of the object is maintained internally. This, however, does not make the object live longer, it just pins it on the tool's internal structures, keeping any relevant state and caches going.

searchDocs.title: IsLocked​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:IsLocked() → boolean-- Whether the instance is currently locked. Checks the lock status of the underlying instance.

searchDocs.title: GetChildren​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:GetChildren() → {instance}-- All children of the instance Retrieves the children for the instance. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: GetDescendants​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:GetDescendants() → {instance}-- All descendants of the instance Retrieves the descendants for the instance. Performance This function may be **very** slow. Avoid using it if possible. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: GetFullName​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:GetFullName() → string-- The fully qualified name for the instance. Retrieves the fully qualified name for the given instance. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: OfClass​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:OfClass( className: string-- The expected class name ) → boolean-- Whether the given class name is equal to the one the instance possesses. Checks the immediate Class of the object. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: FindFirstChild​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:FindFirstChild( name: string-- The instance name ) → instance?-- An instance, which may be null if it was not found. Attempts to find the first child on the instance which matches the given name. Performance This function may silently performs GetChildren for every invocation, if you are going to be repeatedly getting children, and you know they may not suddenly change, it is better you cache the list and retrieve them yourself. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: FindFirstChildOfClass​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:FindFirstChildOfClass( className: string-- The class name of the target instance ) → instance?-- An instance, which may be null if it was not found. Attempts to find the first child on the instance which matches the given class name. Performance This function may silently performs GetChildren for every invocation, if you are going to be repeatedly getting children, and you know they may not suddenly change, it is better you cache the list and retrieve them yourself. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: FindFirstChildWhichIsA​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA( className: string-- The class name of the target instance ) → instance?-- An instance, which may be null if it was not found. Attempts to find the first child on the instance whose class matches or inherits from the given class. Performance This function may silently performs GetChildren for every invocation, if you are going to be repeatedly getting children, and you know they may not suddenly change, it is better you cache the list and retrieve them yourself. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: GetAttribute​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:GetAttribute( attributeName: string-- The name of the target attribute. ) → any?-- The value of the attribute, which may be nil. Attempts to retrieve the attribute with the given name. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.

searchDocs.title: GetAttributes​
searchDocs.content: </> instance:GetAttributes() → {[string]: any?}-- A dictionary containinig all attributes available with their names as the key. Attempts to retrieve all attributes of the instance. Locking This function requires locking to succeed.
